page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at the top centre; left margin carries clipped and cropped letters of the text (edge of the scan, not notes); catchword "Quod" at the lower right.

main_text.p: iinitus demandata exequantur : è quibus libet nominare Dominum Gasparum Rittershusium I. V. Doctorem, virum consultissimum & prudentissimum : Dn. Engelbertum Sibelinum, & D. VVernerum Teschenmacherum Viros doctissimos & diuini verbi praecones fidelissimos. Nonnulli etiam inspectione & institutione mea gaudi fuere, & fructus suae pietatis & diligentiae vberes nunc percipiunt : Alii denique etiamnum meae curae ac disciplinae subditi sunt, qui talia indolis suae edederunt specimina ut non dubitem, quin expectationi vestrae syncere & plene satisfacturi sint, vobisque & patriae ornamento futuri. Intelligitis causas, quibus adductus patrocinio vestro libellum hunc dicare volui: pluribus afferendis superfedeo, ne de benevolentia vestra erga me dubitare videar.

page.notes: The left-margin fragments are edge damage and not transcribed. Several words are doubtful in the scan. Catchword "Quod" is printed at the lower right and is also given as the catchword. Line-end hyphens were resolved into whole words where the printed hyphen was not clearly present.
